```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Jobdaten
jobs = {
    "0": {"processing_time": 95, "due_date": 756, "weight": 4},
    "1": {"processing_time": 50, "due_date": 820, "weight": 1},
    "2": {"processing_time": 31, "due_date": 331, "weight": 10},
    "3": {"processing_time": 7, "due_date": 820, "weight": 9},
    "4": {"processing_time": 82, "due_date": 482, "weight": 2},
    "5": {"processing_time": 73, "due_date": 426, "weight": 10},
    "6": {"processing_time": 16, "due_date": 545, "weight": 2},
    "7": {"processing_time": 93, "due_date": 443, "weight": 2},
    "8": {"processing_time": 34, "due_date": 348, "weight": 1},
    "9": {"processing_time": 34, "due_date": 671, "weight": 10},
    "10": {"processing_time": 66, "due_date": 530, "weight": 1},
    "11": {"processing_time": 55, "due_date": 480, "weight": 7},
    "12": {"processing_time": 70, "due_date": 519, "weight": 1},
    "13": {"processing_time": 35, "due_date": 670, "weight": 3},
    "14": {"processing_time": 71, "due_date": 196, "weight": 10},
    "15": {"processing_time": 55, "due_date": 492, "weight": 10},
    "16": {"processing_time": 85, "due_date": 494, "weight": 4},
    "17": {"processing_time": 38, "due_date": 544, "weight": 4},
    "18": {"processing_time": 71, "due_date": 395, "weight": 2},
    "19": {"processing_time": 8, "due_date": 495, "weight": 1},
    "20": {"processing_time": 38, "due_date": 662, "weight": 8},
    "21": {"processing_time": 38, "due_date": 191, "weight": 10},
    "22": {"processing_time": 80, "due_date": 171, "weight": 8},
    "23": {"processing_time": 86, "due_date": 717, "weight": 9},
    "24": {"processing_time": 9, "due_date": 278, "weight": 10}
}

# Initialisiere das Modell
model = gp.Model()
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
n = len(jobs)
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")

# Zielfunktion: Minimiere die gewichtete Summe der Verspätungen
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[str(j)]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Einschränkungen
# Jeder Job wird genau einmal eingeplant
model.addConstrs((x.sum(i, '*') == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assign_once")
model.addConstrs((x.sum('*', j) == 1 for j in range(n)), name="assigned_once")

# Berechnung der Fertigstellungszeiten
model.addConstrs((C[j] >= gp.quicksum(jobs[str(i)]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in range(n)) for j in range(n)), name="completion_time")

# Berechnung der Verspätungen
model.addConstrs((T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[str(j)]["due_date"] for j in range(n)), name="tardiness")
model.addConstrs((T[j] >= 0 for j in range(n)), name="non_negative_tardiness")

# Lösen des Modells
model.optimize()

# Extrahiere die Lösung
sequence = [j for j in range(n) for i in range(n) if x[i, j].X > 0.5]
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Ausgabe im geforderten Format
import json
print(json.dumps({"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}))
```
